row.name: Heartflow Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=6 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=1.07 tightness=1.58 base_volume_vs_leg=1.28 base_volume_vs_avg=1.24
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: the base gave back 1.07 of the leg; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close -13.1% vs its 20-SMA, -17.7% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The base recorded a giveback of 1.07 (the entire prior leg was retraced inside the consolidation window) and tightness of 1.58 against a 1.0 threshold, and the chart confirms this: the shaded base region shows wide, overlapping red bars cascading from ~60 down to ~44, a clear declining structure rather than an orderly consolidation. RE also fails with the burst bar at only 0.34x the prior 5-session range, meaning the signal bar is not even the widest of the recent sessions — the expansion is not genuine.
claude.key_risk: The base is a visible downtrend with heavy giveback, not a tight consolidation, so any follow-through is fighting against a broken structure and significant overhead supply from prior trading between $55–$60.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps below the burst close of 46.69 or if the first 30 minutes show continued selling pressure given the broken base structure.
